text.p: Algeria expects an "average harvest" of cereals in the 1996/97 season, Agriculture Minister Noureddine Bahbouh was quoted as saying on Saturday.

"The cereal harvest for the current season would be an average one...Most of the crop areas has been rescued from the drought effects by April's rains," said Bahboudh quoted by the official APS news agency.
Bahbouh gave no figure for the harvest but agricultural experts put Algeria's average harvest at slightly more than 2.0 million tonnes.
Algeria harvested a record 4.9 million tonnes of cereals in the last 1995/1996 season, beating the 3.6 million tonnes record set in 1990/91, government data showed.
Trade experts estimate Algeria's grain imports in the year to June 30, 1996 at 4.1 million tonnes for wheat and 1.1 tonnes for other cereals.
